one_liner: Cloud-based messaging app; developers build bots and clients against the Telegram Bot API / MTProto API.

auth.evidence_quote: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created. The token looks something like 123456:ABC-DEF1234ghIkl-zyx57W2v1u123ew11.
auth.notes: Telegram calls this a bot token (issued by BotFather), embedded directly in the request URL path rather than an OAuth or API-key header; not called an 'API key' by the vendor.

access.evidence_quote: All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and need to be presented in this form: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME.
access.notes: Bot creation via BotFather is free and instant; fetched page did not state pricing but Telegram Bot API is widely known to be free.

api.evidence_quote: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created.
api.notes: No official Telegram-published MCP server found; numerous community MCP servers wrap the Bot API.

verdict.rationale: Bot token creation is free and instant via BotFather with no review process for basic bot usage.
